statement: In the coefficient space P9 × P19 of quadric/cubic pairs, the singular-sextic locus, the locus with a tritangent having two colliding contact points, and the locus with distinct tritangents sharing a contact are irreducible reduced hypersurfaces. Their respective bidegrees in quadric and cubic coefficients are (33,34), (744,592), and (8862,5236).
